_about: The A and N thresholds: the values `agentcake eval --gate` judges. They were set on 2026-11-12 and only the project's owner changes them. The maintainers' own tests check every entry against the project's goals: `goal` says the goal's threshold in words, and op, value and unit say the same thing.

_fields.goal: the threshold in words, as the project's goals state it
_fields.op, value, unit: the comparison the gate makes: share is 0 to 1, points are percentage points, s and ms are seconds and milliseconds
_fields.statistic: how the measured value is made from the samples (the definition the tables print next to every value)
_fields.data: the data sets the value is measured on. gated: what the gate judges (each one that has samples must pass, and at least one must have samples). reference: printed beside it, never judged. A1 counts clean human recordings only; anything built from PostHog replays is reference only (its answers come from tool-call times and 'probably human' cuts); splices whose human half is a lab script only show that the mechanics work.
_fields.measured_by: agentcake eval, or the tests of the step that measures it (the gate lists those and does not judge them)
_fields.case: the case of the sample lists (eval/README.md, `case`) the threshold is measured on, where there is one
_fields.min_per_group, n: sample sizes the threshold asks for

thresholds.measure: clean human sessions judged agent as a whole
thresholds.statistic: sessions whose class is agent / judged sessions (too little data left out, A8 counts them)

thresholds.measure: local agent sessions with answers (Claude in Chrome, headed Playwright moving like a hand) judged agent or mixed
thresholds.statistic: sessions whose four-layer class is agent or mixed / judged sessions of those groups (too little data left out, A8 counts them)
median over mixed sessions of (actions whose who is right / actions decided), the timeline's who
median over mixed sessions of |agent share by action - true agent share by action| in percentage points (the largest is printed, not judged)

median over the true hand-offs in the sessions judged Human + agent: seconds from each true hand-off to the nearest one the timeline found in the same direction, human to agent or agent to human (one it did not find, or found only the other way round, counts as over the limit); no such hand-off is no samples, which is not a pass. Printed beside it, never judged: over every true hand-off, how many were found and missed, the share within the limit, the largest error found and the extra hand-offs marked, and how many mixed sessions were judged Human + agent

thresholds.measure: automated browsers that do not give a name: Agent, Automated browser, with the reason that says so
thresholds.statistic: sessions whose class is agent in the automated row with the automated-browser reason / automated-browser sessions

thresholds.measure: the 10 named User-Agents: name and category right
thresholds.statistic: User-Agents whose list id and class (Agent or Bot) are right / 10, each judged as a local session with nothing but its User-Agent

thresholds.goal: All counted as Human, never judged Agent, and the reasons say why. A real phone or tablet that meets every condition is a plain Human and shows no percent; the rest are marked limited evidence, with no Unknown.
thresholds.measure: phones, tablets and sessions with fewer action segments than the minimum: never Agent. A real phone or tablet (its browser says it is one, its environment records fit one, and no other layer found anything) is stored and shown as Human, with no percent; the rest are stored as too little data and shown as Human with limited evidence
thresholds.statistic: such sessions whose class is too little data, or human for a real phone or tablet / such sessions (no other layer naming them)

thresholds.goal: T22: at least 3 runs per group, all judged right
thresholds.measure: listed bots are Bot, automated browsers run by a local AI tool or a cloud script are Agent, Automated browser
thresholds.statistic: T22 sessions whose class, row and verification are right / T22 sessions, every group at least min_per_group

thresholds.measure: page views that ran the script: their token reached cake and matched the session
thresholds.statistic: page views with a verified token / page views, over the labelled sessions of a CAKE_HOME

thresholds.measure: tokens with changed bytes, replayed, or older than 15 minutes: refused
p50 latency the middleware adds over 1,000 requests
thresholds.measured_by: edge/node tests, the browser check edge/node/scripts/browser-check.mjs and node edge/node/scripts/latency.js --requests 1000 --max-p50-diff-ms 5

thresholds.measure: Web Bot Auth: 5 signed examples verify, 5 with one changed byte do not, 5 unsigned are 'no signature'
Nginx, Apache and Caddy log lines matched to page sessions by IP hash, User-Agent and 30 seconds
